v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given the day is Friday and there are no existing events, when meeting duration is 30 minutes on a Monday, then the earliest suggested slot is 09:00.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given the day is Friday and there are no existing events, when meeting duration is requested, then no slots v2_human 15:00 are returned.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_6: Given the day is Friday, when meeting duration is requested then slots v1_human 15:00 are returned.

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: The day parameter is a valid string and used to determine if the day is Friday.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: On Fridays, no meeting may start v2_human 15:00.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_5: Three letter abbreviation is used for day.

v2_human_g2_goal: The system takes list of existing events and meeting duration and returns all available slots for that day. It takes into account the working hours, avoids conflicts with events and lunch break.
v2_human_g2_input: events => list of dictionaries. Format: each list item is dictionary with keys "start" and "end" in "HH:MM" format. Any valid time between "00:00" and "23:59" is valid value. Meeting duration => int. Format: no. of minutes for meeting. Any +ve integer is valid value.
v2_human_g2_output: returns list of valid meeting times where each time is in "HH:MM" format. Returns available slots till 15:00 on Fridays working hours while returns time slots available from 9:00 on other weekdays.
